_comment: G4 retrieval gold. SPLIT INTO dev AND holdout (A12): thresholds are calibrated on dev ONLY and measured on holdout. REVISED 2026-07-28 for REPRESENTATIVENESS: the first version was dominated by bare service titles, which score cosine 1.000 and flattered top-1 to 100% while natural questions were failing («شو المستندات المطلوبة لإعادة قيد مطلقة؟» retrieved the wrong service). Real users type questions, not titles, so questions now dominate and only 2 bare titles remain. Arabic is a mix of fosha and Lebanese dialect in Arabic script; Arabizi is excluded by decision (detect_language misroutes it — PROGRESS Findings 2026-07-27).
